The official route requires multipart/form-data with a binary file part. The current REST binding can preserve JSON and UTF-8 body_raw but cannot construct an arbitrary-byte multipart body without corruption.

The official contract promises a redirect to a signed download URL but does not pin that target to the Attio API origin. The REST transport correctly rejects cross-origin redirects, so this route cannot be admitted without live same-origin proof or weakening credential and SSRF boundaries.
